issues.description: Script defines server endpoints (duolingopro.net, api.duolingopro.net) and references server-side processing for XP, gems, and other features. This strongly suggests user data or actions are transmitted to third-party servers.
issues.recommendation: Review all network requests and ensure no sensitive user data is transmitted. Avoid sending cookies, authentication tokens, or personal information to third-party servers.

issues.description: Script reads document.cookie to extract language settings. While not directly exfiltrated in the visible code, this is a privacy-sensitive operation.
issues.recommendation: Do not read cookies unless strictly necessary. Ensure no sensitive cookies (e.g., session/auth tokens) are accessed or transmitted.
